name: Knight of Diamonds
source: Knight of Diamonds is one of the 3 Knights that govern Wonderland along with Queen of Hearts. He swore his loyalty to Knight of Spades. After Ririka escape to Earth, he infiltrated her school as an English teacher. His personal weapon is a saber.
